facts.text: My love for music began when I was about 6 years old.
My grandmother used to take me to another lady's home just outside of Mandeville.
The home outside of Mandeville had a grand piano that I remembered seeing each time.
I used to play random noise on the piano keys as a child.
I used to go to that house once every couple months.
I have only ever been to that house less than 20 times in my life.
I started rapping in early high school around 7th grade.
I started rapping at deCarterate College in Mandeville.
I and my friends made beats by knocking our hands on tables in classrooms.
I took turns freestyling with my friends while making beats.
People gave me recognition for my choice of words and flow.
People told me I was cut out to be a famous musician someday.
I booked recording sessions at a studio named Outta Space Records.
Outta Space Records was run by my friend Steelchest.
Steelchest pushed me to do my best every recording session.
I released my first EP entitled Untitled.
My first EP did not get that much attention.
I decided to try music production for the first time in my high school years around 10th grade.
I had tried making a beat years prior but it did not go well.
I became close friends with a prominent Jamaican music producer named SOS Dynamikz.
I saw SOS Dynamikz making a beat at my best friends' Marc and Matthew's home.
Since then, I have been on and off with my music.
I have been distracted by women, drugs, and money.
Today, I can confidently create the music I hear in my head to a 75% accurate level.
I already feel bad about the years I wasted not releasing music.
In total, I have released less than 50 songs.
This year will be completely different for me in terms of releasing music.
